LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruit.label: Feather Shadow from Another Realm
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruit.letterText: A stabilized feather-like projection has appeared near the colony. The visitor calls herself Neiyu. She is not the original body, but rather a lively projection cast into this world by a Milira. Less like an aloof divine remnant and more like a breeze that arrives with a smile, she is curious, lively, and clearly has no intention of acting overly solemn. She says she can stay, or simply leave. The choice is yours.
